question: Where was the 2025 Regional Forum on Sustainable Development (RFSD) for the UNECE region held on April 2–3?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Geneva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2025 Regional Forum on Sustainable Development (RFSD)** for the **UNECE region** was hosted in **Geneva**.
 
• **UNECE** stands for the **United Nations Economic Commission for Europe**, which works towards fostering sustainable development and economic cooperation in the European region.</
